title: Personal Credit Cards: Cashing Out Points When a Card Is Closed
content:
When a Personal Credit Cards account is being given up, its cardholder can take the card's rewards in cash.

## Scope

A cardholder closing a card who asks for the points in cash receives the card's entire stock of unredeemed points in a single redemption, paid into a checking account.

## Trace left by the cash-out

The cash-out shows up on the card and nowhere else. Its entry on the card names the checking account that receives the money and gives the cash value. The card rule posts nothing to that checking account's own ledger, and no part of the rule turns on such a posting.

## Making the cash-out

Taking points as cash is something the cardholder does personally. The agent unlocks the customer-side tool `cash_out_closing_card_points_6700a44f` and hands it across, and the customer themselves runs it. Each run posts one redemption entry on the card for the points supplied, notes the receiving checking account and the cash value, and removes those points from the card's unredeemed stock immediately.

| Input | Content | Form |
|---|---|---|
| `card_account_id` | the card whose points are being paid out, as found by the card account lookup | identifier |
| `checking_account_id` | the cardholder's checking account that receives the cash, as found by the checking account lookup | identifier |
| `reward_points` | points cashed out | whole positive integer, no decimal part |
| `amount` | cash value deposited | USD, positive, two decimals rounded half-up |

## Receipt

A completed run returns `status` "cashed_out" with `card_txn_id`, `card_account_id`, `receiving_account_id` (the account the cash-out entry records as paid), `reward_points`, `amount`, `posted_date` and `new_rewards_balance`, which shows what remains in points on the card. The cash-out stands once this receipt comes back.
